description: Pin for the pytorchsim-triton-opt toolchain layer, which the codegen route lowers through. Kept out of github-releases.json so the main torchsim_base image is not rebuilt when this moves. CI builds ghcr.io/.../torchsim_psto_base:psto-<12 hex> when missing, pin = sha256 of this file plus Dockerfile.psto. `ref` is a commit, not a branch, so any upstream change -- including the toolchain release its setup/versions.env points at -- moves the pin. The repository is private: the workflow needs a PAT in secrets.PSTO_TOKEN, since the default Actions token is scoped to this repository.
